name: Canon Provider and Device Data Fabric Completion Hardening
description: Complete the existing Canon provider/device subsystem with deployment-safe action commands, durable idempotency and leases, strict provider resource allowlists, bounded cursors and payloads, typed CloudKit phone instructions, explicit iPhone upload grants, per-root device checkpoints, and expanded conformance evidence.
purpose: Extend the existing provider/device data fabric to the maximum locally verifiable implementation state while retaining fail-closed authority, provenance, continuous retrieval, and honest live-provider and physical-device evidence boundaries.
features: Gemini Files and File Search adapter
Schema-validated read, write, inference, and phone-instruction commands
Durable process leases and fail-closed idempotency records
Incremental continuous sync and autonomous retrieval
Content hashing, deduplication, checkpoints, dead letters, and receipts
Explicit device upload grants and per-root CloudKit cursors
justification: The canonical project canon-provider-device-data-fabric already owns these capabilities and provider/device boundaries. This work must extend that project in place and must not create a parallel adapter stack or control plane.
